description:
Return current, source-cited UX best practices for what you are building or reviewing — usability heuristics, forms and validation, navigation, feedback and error recovery, WCAG 2.2 interaction requirements, performance, visual direction and responsive design systems, motion and animation, AI features, and research — so quality UI and accessibility come from one place. Complements a11y_component_guidance (which gives one component's ARIA contract).

Use this BEFORE designing a flow or screen, and again when reviewing UI for usability. Each topic carries a confidence label (stable / standard / emerging), the sources it rests on and whether they were read in full, and places where sources disagree. The guidance is reviewed on a 6-month cycle; the response states whether the review is overdue.

Args:
  - task (string, optional): what you are building or reviewing; relevant topics are selected from it.
  - topic (string, optional): one of heuristics, forms, navigation, feedback, accessibility, performance, visual-design, motion, ai, research, or "all". Overrides task selection.
  - mode ('build' | 'review'): default 'build'; 'review' adds review questions.
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): default 'markdown'.

Returns (json): { review: { lastReviewed, nextReviewDue, stale, message }, topics: [{ id, title, confidence, summary, rules, tensions, reviewQuestions, wcag, sources }] }.

Automated and heuristic guidance is necessary, not sufficient: it does not replace testing with real users and assistive technology.

mode.description: 'build' returns rules to apply before writing UI; 'review' adds questions to ask of an existing design or implementation.

task.description: What you are building or reviewing, e.g. "a checkout form" or "settings page". Used to pick the relevant topics.

topic.description: A specific topic to return instead of auto-selecting. Available: heuristics, forms, navigation, feedback, accessibility, performance, visual-design, motion, ai, research, or "all".

name: a11y_ux_guidance
title: Get UX best-practice guidance
